mapper.select: SELECT detail_id as id, dict_id as dict_id, label, value, dict_sort, create_time, update_time FROM dict_detail WHERE detail_id = #{id}
SELECT detail_id as id, dict_id as dict_id, label, value, dict_sort, create_time, update_time FROM dict_detail WHERE dict_id = #{dictId} ORDER BY dict_sort ASC, detail_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dict_detail ( dict_id, label, value, dict_sort, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{dictId}, #{label}, #{value}, #{dictSort}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE dict_detail SET label = #{label}, value = #{value}, dict_sort = #{dictSort}, update_time = NOW() WHERE detail_id = #{id}
